description: Birth and death dates from published reference works, by Civgraph person id. The Browse pages use them only where History of Parliament and Wikidata give no date, citing the work and page. Facts only: no text from the works is held here. Where an entry's preferOver names a field, the reference work's date is shown in place of Wikidata's, because a second source agrees with it; the note says why. Entries from Elliott & Flackes (1999) carry checkedAgainst: the second sources, per field, that give the same date (a date is added only when one does, at the precision the sources support). Where the book is wrong and the second sources agree with each other, the field holds their date and bookGives records the book's.
